content.content:
This page allows you to select a pre-configured training scenario to practice assessments. Each scenario represents a different case study with realistic data.

Choose a scenario from the list on the left, review the details, then click Start session to begin. Your session will be added to your active sessions list.

panel.content: Configure the subject details for this scenario. Check "Randomise" to generate a new value each time the scenario is loaded.

panel.label: Stubbed CRN
panel.hint: Replaces the CRN above with a shared test CRN that has fixed data in local, dev and test, so the About and supervision package pages show that data instead of calling the real services. If you pick one, Sentence Plan shows its canned criminogenic needs, not the ones you set on the Criminogenic Needs tab. The launcher never changes their data.

items.hint: Tier B confirmed. Standard supervision phase, early engagement complete.

Tier C provisional. In-flight case, OASys review not started.

field.label: SAN Assessment Version
field.hint: Unix timestamp in milliseconds (leave blank for current version)

panel.content: Configure the criminogenic needs scores and flags for this scenario. Click on each section to expand and edit the values. Check "Randomise" to generate a new value each time the scenario is loaded.

items.hint: The values below are returned in place of the ARNS API for this CRN. Only used with the SAN Private Beta flag, as Sentence Plan only shows criminogenic needs for Private Beta. Untick to use the data held by the real ARNS API in dev and test. When running locally, unticking gives the canned needs Wiremock returns for every CRN.

panel.content: Flags control special behaviors and feature toggles for the training scenario. These affect how the target application behaves during the training session.

panel.label: Active flags

This page shows all your active training sessions. Each session represents a case study you can use to practice assessments.

For each session, select a target service and click Generate link to open the assessment. Use Delete session to remove individual sessions, or Reset all sessions to clear everything and start fresh.
